name: Tofu Parmesan over Linguini with Tomato & Mushroom Sauce

instructions.primary_message: Cut the tofu into approximately ¼-inch thick planks along the long side. Sandwich the tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Fill a large pot halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
0.68 kg white mushrooms
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince the garlic. Slice the mushrooms. Transfer both to a large bowl and set aside.
Combine spices in a small bowl; stir to combine the spice mix and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp Italian seasoning
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
1 ½ tsp onion powder
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When pasta is done, drain in a colander, and rinse under cold water; set aside to drain further.
Return the pot to medium heat; add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the mushrooms and garlic; cook, stirring often, until mushrooms soften, about 2 minutes.
Add tomato sauce and spices to the pot and stir to combine. Cover and let simmer over medium-low for 5 minutes; turn off the heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
4 ½ (213 ml) cans tomato sauce
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp Italian seasoning
¼ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Cut tofu planks into approximately 2-inch wide rectangles along the short side. Arrange tofu on a baking sheet in a single layer. Season with half of the spice mix, followed by half of the bread crumbs. Press down lightly with your hands to help the breadcrumbs adhere.
Carefully turn the tofu planks over. Season with remaining spice mix and bread crumbs. Press down lightly with your hands to help the breadcrumbs adhere.
Preheat a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat.
When the skillet is hot, add olive oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add the tofu and cook until golden brown on one side, 3-4 minutes. Cook in batches if necessary.
Using a spatula, carefully flip the tofu over and top each piece with Parmesan cheese. Cook until the other side has turned golden brown and the cheese has melted, 2-3 minutes.
Add the pasta back to the pot with the sauce and toss until well coated. Cook until heated through, 2-3 minutes.
Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Divide pasta and sauce between bowls or dishes. Top with tofu and sprinkle with parsley. Enjoy!
